targetApp.name: TICVAI Control
targetApp.note: **TICVAI operates all five**, whoever signs in. The partner portal, the accreditation intake, the developer portal and the sign-up are outward faces of the control plane, not separate products — but their users are not TICVAI staff, and the permission model has to hold that line. **P17 added 11 September 2026**: a prospect buying TICVAI has no tenant and no cell, so the control plane is the only thing that can serve them.
